2607.01590.title: Hawk: Harnessing Hardware-Aware Knowledge for High-Performance NPU Kernel Generation
2607.01590.paper_summary: Developing high-performance kernels for Neural Processing Units (NPUs) is a critical industry bottleneck, requiring developers to manually navigate implicit hardware constraints and strict memory hierarchies. While large language models offer immense automation potential, they fail catastrophically on NPUs due to a fundamental lack of hardware-specific priors. Naively transplanting code snippets from similar NPU kernels may pass the compiler, but it consistently triggers runtime crashes and performance degradation by blindly violating underlying hardware constraints. To overcome this, we introduce Hawk, a training-free framework that harnesses hardware-aware knowledge through three core modules: (1) Run-Time Knowledge Synthesis Module, which employs a Triple-Part Executable Knowledge Representation to inherently couple the error context with executable semantics; (2) Bottleneck-Aware Knowledge Retrieval Module, which implements a 2D-Retrieval paradigm to project queries into orthogonal syntactic and hardware-aligned semantic spaces; and (3) Effect-Driven Knowledge Distillation Module, which leverages LLM-driven semantic arbitration to continuously distill the knowledge by pruning errors and consolidating redundancies based on the empirical execution feedback. Extensive evaluations on real-world NPU workloads demonstrate that Hawk elevates generation accuracy from 49.4% to 80.0%, while achieving up to a 2.2x execution speedup over state-of-the-art baselines.
2607.01590.paper_summary_zh: 開發高效能的神經處理單元 (NPU) 核心是業界的一個關鍵瓶頸，要求開發者手動應對隱含的硬體限制和嚴格的記憶體層級。雖然大型語言模型提供了巨大的自動化潛力，但由於缺乏硬體特定的先驗知識，它們在 NPU 上的表現卻慘不忍睹。將類似 NPU 核心的程式碼片段天真地移植過來可能會通過編譯器，但它卻會因盲目違反底層硬體限制而持續觸發運行時崩潰和性能下降。為了解決這個問題，我們引入了 Hawk，一個無需訓練的框架，通過三個核心模組利用硬體感知知識：(1) 運行時知識合成模組，該模組採用三部分可執行知識表示，將錯誤上下文與可執行語義內在地結合；(2) 瓶頸感知知識檢索模組，該模組實現了一種 2D 檢索範式，將查詢投射到正交的語法和硬體對齊的語義空間；(3) 效果驅動知識蒸餾模組，該模組利用 LLM 驅動的語義仲裁，通過根據經驗執行反饋修剪錯誤和整合冗餘來持續蒸餾知識。在真實世界的 NPU 工作負載上進行的廣泛評估顯示，Hawk 將生成準確率從 49.4% 提升至 80.0%，同時在最先進的基準上實現了高達 2.2 倍的執行速度提升。
